text:
https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing
OpenAI API Pricing · developers.openai.com · retrieved 2026-09-03 ~18:08 MDT

WHAT IT IS: Official list prices GPT-6 Astra at $10 input / $50 output per 1M tokens short-context Standard, with long-context 2x input and 1.5x output, Fast mode 2x, and a 10% uplift on regional/data-residency endpoints for models released on or after 2026-03-05.
WHY IT MATTERS: Capture Economy / Metered Mind — the meter is public and the residency tax is explicit; operators now have a dated rate card for frontier computer-use work.
KM ANGLE: The flagship is not the product. The product is the meter plus the 10 percent you pay to keep the work in a named region.
GRADE: MEASURED   CAUTION: Trusted Access / Daybreak first; Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise and general API are ‘coming days,’ not GA on this hour. Enterprise admin enablement is off by default.

https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/gpt-6-astra-frontier-intelligence-for-work-now-available-in-microsoft-foundry/
Microsoft Azure Blog · azure.microsoft.com · 2026-09-03

WHAT IT IS: Major-cloud Foundry post publishes the same $10/$50 Standard Global short-context card and a US Data Zone card at $11/$55 — the 10% residency uplift in an enterprise SKU table.
WHY IT MATTERS: Capture Economy + agentic enterprise — computer-use across apps without dedicated APIs, consumption start without reserved capacity, residency priced as a line item.
KM ANGLE: Same model, two meters. The extra dime per million is the fee for not leaving the zone.
GRADE: MEASURED   CAUTION: Limited Access Program; availability expanding ‘over the coming days.’ Consumption varies by workload. Category language only — source names the suite.

https://ifm.ai/k2/press-release/
Institute of Foundation Models · ifm.ai · 2026-09-03

WHAT IT IS: IFM/MBZUAI ships K2 Horizon, six models 0.9B–375B, Apache 2.0, with weights, code, training data, and methodology; 32B/36B-A4B framed for local and on-prem hosting; day-zero vLLM/SGLang/HF.
WHY IT MATTERS: Sovereignty counter-move against the Astra metered flagship landing the same day — forkable stack vs rented computer-use.
KM ANGLE: One lab sells the meter. Another published the weights, the data, and the method on the same calendar day.
GRADE: DIRECTIONAL   CAUTION: Vendor claims on benchmark SOTA and ‘largest fully open’ are theirs; verify weights on Hugging Face before airing as operator-ready.
